observation_source.source_policy: Fresh KMA API Hub station-date observations; source values > -90 for temperature; RN_DAY=-9 maps to zero following kmahub; other negative rain values excluded and audited. Daily equal-weight means of actual valid contributors, minimum50, no imputation or 62/n scaling.
observation_source.required_stations_policy: Preserves supplied package minimum50; NOT a KMA API QC flag.
observation_source.qc_flag_origin: Derived validity/count checks on returned measurements, not independent instrument QC.

calibration_protocol: same-case source-year pairs; HIST_END < INIT_DATE; SOURCE_YEAR != target year
observation_policy: derived variable validity and >=50 contributors; not instrument/API QC; no imputation or rescaling
probability_reference: training observational terciles, linear quantile 1/3 and 2/3
